answer:
Promptfoo version 0.124.0 introduces support for comma-separated OR values in the `--filter-metadata` option. This allows users to specify multiple values for a single metadata key, with any of these values being acceptable for a test case to pass the filter.

The relevant information is found in two parts of the context:

1. The feature description: 
   - "Features: **cli:** support comma-separated OR values in --filter-metadata ([#11320](https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/11320)) ([b7cae9f](https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/commit/b7cae9ff5b756fdca72af54e0d3dcc25d5238d4c))"

2. The command line documentation:
   - "`--filter-metadata <key=value>`: Filter tests by metadata substring. Commas separate OR values (`\,` is a comma); repeated flags use AND."

Thus, the new form of value accepted is comma-separated values for OR logic within a single metadata key. [3] promptfoo/0.124.0.md (lines 20-31) and [2] promptfoo/site/docs/usage/command-line.md (lines 117-117)
